resources.string: Sign in to Antigravity with Google
Claire will use your Google account to call Antigravity models through Google Cloud Code Assist. Sign in in your browser; your Google password is never typed into Claire.

Claire needs your own Google OAuth client. In Google Cloud Console, create OAuth client credentials of the Desktop app type (or reuse the client from your own Antigravity install) and paste the Client ID and Client Secret below. They are stored encrypted on this phone and only ever sent to Google.
